description: This file defines the SubunitModel class which is responsible for serializing Subunit entity objects for the OrangeHRM system. It uses traits and interfaces for API serialization, setting up entity data and defining filters and attribute names.

classes.name: SubunitModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing Subunit entities for API responses, implementing normalization interface and using a trait for common serialization logic.
